outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo (sequence data), not a plot of averaged/aggregated quantitative data requiring individual points.

The scatter plot in panel B shows mean ± SEM as horizontal lines with individual gray dots overlaid for each biological replicate; the accompanying disk-diffusion photographs are not plots and need no individual points.
Panel C consists of epifluorescence micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot showing mean ± SEM with individual yellow circle data points for each cell overlaid.
Scatter plot showing mean ± SEM with individual blue circle data points for each cell overlaid.
Panel F shows super-resolution PALM microscopy images of individual cells, not a summary plot.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster.
Scatter plot of molecule percentage in clusters shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell.
